title: Three Kingdoms Prologue: Oath of the Peach Garden

series.title: Three Kingdoms Prologue: Oath of the Peach Garden

fullText.simplified:
刘备

    这是2000年前的一天。
    一个男人走在街上，他二十多岁，他姓刘，叫刘备。
    刘备会做一些小东西，做好以后就拿到街上来卖。他已经卖了四五年了，卖得还不错。但是从去年冬天开始，买东西的人变少了。
    刘备知道为什么。去年冬天特别冷，很多人没有吃的东西，生病的人特别多。一些过得特别不好的人去官府，请官员帮忙，但是都没有得到帮助。后来，冬天过去了，很多人没有看到春天，他们死在了冬天。
    想到这儿，刘备有点儿生气。
    在官员们心里，做更大的官是更重要的事。他们每天都忙着找钱，还让过得不好的人拿钱给他们，一点儿都不记得那些死了的人。北边的黄军打好人，拿过得不好的人的东西，官员们只知道害怕，也不去打他们。这样的官员，怎么会关心过得不好的人？
    刘备走得很慢，他对自己也有一点儿生气。
    他生气自己没有钱，如果有钱，他就可以帮那些过得不好的人，也可以做更多让国家变好的事。
    前面是官府，有一些人站在街边，他们在看官府大门上的一张纸。纸上写了很多字。很多人没有上过学，不认识那些字，大声问：“谁认识这些字？请读一读！”
    刘备站在后面，说：“这是官府写给大家的，上面说的是，现在北边的黄军越来越多，他们做的坏事也越来越多，官府希望大家帮忙，一起打黄军。谁帮的忙最大，官府就让谁做将军。”
    刘备刚读完，就有人高兴地说：“我去打黄军，我要做将军！”也有人害怕地说：“黄军的人那么多，官府都没办法，我去了还回得来吗？”还有人生气地说：“我不去，我只帮对我好的人。虽然黄军不对，但官府也不是好人！”
    刘备没有说话，安静地站在街边，他知道每个人的意思。他也有很多话想说，但是没有人懂他。
fullText.traditional:
劉備

    這是2000年前的一天。
    一個男人走在街上，他二十多歲，他姓劉，叫劉備。
    劉備會做一些小東西，做好以後就拿到街上來賣。他已經賣了四五年了，賣得還不錯。但是從去年冬天開始，買東西的人變少了。
    劉備知道為什麼。去年冬天特別冷，很多人沒有吃的東西，生病的人特別多。一些過得特別不好的人去官府，請官員幫忙，但是都沒有得到幫助。後來，冬天過去了，很多人沒有看到春天，他們死在了冬天。
    想到這兒，劉備有點兒生氣。
    在官員們心裡，做更大的官是更重要的事。他們每天都忙著找錢，還讓過得不好的人拿錢給他們，一點兒都不記得那些死了的人。北邊的黃軍打好人，拿過得不好的人的東西，官員們只知道害怕，也不去打他們。這樣的官員，怎麼會關心過得不好的人？
    劉備走得很慢，他對自己也有一點兒生氣。
    他生氣自己沒有錢，如果有錢，他就可以幫那些過得不好的人，也可以做更多讓國家變好的事。
    前面是官府，有一些人站在街邊，他們在看官府大門上的一張紙。紙上寫了很多字。很多人沒有上過學，不認識那些字，大聲問：“誰認識這些字？請讀一讀！”
    劉備站在後面，說：“這是官府寫給大家的，上面說的是，現在北邊的黃軍越來越多，他們做的壞事也越來越多，官府希望大家幫忙，一起打黃軍。誰幫的忙最大，官府就讓誰做將軍。”
    劉備剛讀完，就有人高興地說：“我去打黃軍，我要做將軍！”也有人害怕地說：“黃軍的人那麼多，官府都沒辦法，我去了還回得來嗎？”還有人生氣地說：“我不去，我只幫對我好的人。雖然黃軍不對，但官府也不是好人！”
    劉備沒有說話，安靜地站在街邊，他知道每個人的意思。他也有很多話想說，但是沒有人懂他。

sentences.english: A man was walking in the street. He was in his twenties. His surname was Liu, and his name was Liu Bei.

sentences.simplified: 刘备会做一些小东西，做好以后就拿到街上来卖。
sentences.traditional: 劉備會做一些小東西，做好以後就拿到街上來賣。

sentences.english: Liu Bei would make little things. When he had finished making them, he would sell them on the street.

sentences.simplified: 他已经卖了四五年了，卖得还不错。
sentences.traditional: 他已經賣了四五年了，賣得還不錯。
sentences.pinyin: tā yǐ jīng mài le sì wǔ nián le mài de hái bú cuò
sentences.english: He had been selling them for four or five years already, and they were selling pretty well.

sentences.simplified: 但是从去年冬天开始，买东西的人变少了。
sentences.traditional: 但是從去年冬天開始，買東西的人變少了。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì cóng qù nián dōng tiān kāi shǐ mǎi dōng xi de rén biàn shǎo le

sentences.simplified: 刘备知道为什么。去年冬天特别冷，
sentences.traditional: 劉備知道為什麼。去年冬天特別冷，

sentences.english: Liu Bei knew why. Last winter was particularly cold.

sentences.simplified: 很多人没有吃的东西，生病的人特别多。
sentences.traditional: 很多人沒有吃的東西，生病的人特別多。
sentences.pinyin: hěn duō rén méi yǒu chī de dōng xi shēng bìng de rén tè bié duō
sentences.english: Many people had nothing to eat, and the number of sick people was especially high.

sentences.simplified: 一些过得特别不好的人去官府，请官员帮忙，
sentences.traditional: 一些過得特別不好的人去官府，請官員幫忙，

sentences.english: Some people who were having an especially hard time went to the government to ask the officials for help, ..

sentences.simplified: 但是都没有得到帮助。
sentences.traditional: 但是都沒有得到幫助。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì dōu méi yǒu dé dào bāng zhù
sentences.english: .. but they did not get any help.

sentences.simplified: 后来，冬天过去了，很多人没有看到春天，他们死在了冬天。
sentences.traditional: 後來，冬天過去了，很多人沒有看到春天，他們死在了冬天。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái dōng tiān guò qù le hěn duō rén méi yǒu kàn dào chūn tiān tā men sǐ zài le dōng tiān
sentences.english: Later, the winter passed by. Many people did not see the spring; they died in the winter.

sentences.simplified: 想到这儿，刘备有点儿生气。
sentences.traditional: 想到這兒，劉備有點兒生氣。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎng dào zhè‘r liú bèi yǒu diǎn'r shēng qì
sentences.english: Thinking about this, Liu Bei became a little angry.

sentences.simplified: 在官员们心里，做更大的官是更重要的事。
sentences.traditional: 在官員們心裡，做更大的官是更重要的事。
sentences.pinyin: zài guān yuán men xīn li zuò gèng dà de guān shì gèng zhòng yào de shì
sentences.english: In the minds of the officials, becoming a bigger official was the most important thing.

sentences.simplified: 他们每天都忙着找钱，
sentences.traditional: 他們每天都忙著找錢，
sentences.pinyin: tā men měi tiān dōu máng zhe zhǎo qián
sentences.english: They were busy looking for money every day.

sentences.traditional: 還讓過得不好的人拿錢給他們，一點兒都不記得那些死了的人。

sentences.english: The yellow soldiers in the north fought good people and took things from people who had hard lives.

sentences.simplified: 官员们只知道害怕，也不去打他们。
sentences.traditional: 官員們只知道害怕，也不去打他們。
sentences.pinyin: guān yuán men zhǐ zhī dào hài pà yě bú qù dǎ tā men
sentences.english: The officials only knew how to be afraid and did not go and fight them.

sentences.simplified: 这样的官员，怎么会关心过得不好的人？
sentences.traditional: 這樣的官員，怎麼會關心過得不好的人？
sentences.pinyin: zhè yàng de guān yuán zěn me huì guān xīn guò de bù hǎo de rén
sentences.english: How could officials like this care about people who had hard lives?

sentences.simplified: 刘备走得很慢，他对自己也有一点儿生气。
sentences.traditional: 劉備走得很慢，他對自己也有一點兒生氣。
sentences.pinyin: liú bèi zǒu de hěn màn tā duì zì jǐ yě yǒu yì diǎn'r shēng qì
sentences.english: Liu Bei walked slowly, and he was a little angry with himself.

sentences.traditional: 他生氣自己沒有錢，
sentences.pinyin: tā shēng qì zì jǐ méi yǒu qián
sentences.english: He was angry that he didn’t have any money.

sentences.simplified: 如果有钱，他就可以帮那些过得不好的人，也可以做更多让国家变好的事。
sentences.traditional: 如果有錢，他就可以幫那些過得不好的人，也可以做更多讓國家變好的事。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ yǒu qián tā jiù kě yǐ bāng nà xiē guò de bù hǎo de rén yě kě yǐ zuò gèng duō ràng guó jiā biàn hǎo de shì
sentences.english: If he had money, he could help the people who had hard lives and do more to make the country better.

sentences.simplified: 前面是官府，有一些人站在街边，
sentences.traditional: 前面是官府，有一些人站在街邊，
sentences.pinyin: qián miàn shì guān fǔ yǒu yì xiē rén zhàn zài jiē biān
sentences.english: The government building was in front. Some people were standing in the street.

sentences.english: They were looking at a piece of paper on the gate of the government building. Many characters were written on the paper.

sentences.simplified: 很多人没有上过学，不认识那些字，大声问：
sentences.traditional: 很多人沒有上過學，不認識那些字，大聲問：

sentences.simplified: “谁认识这些字？请读一读！”
sentences.traditional: “誰認識這些字？請讀一讀！”
sentences.pinyin: shéi rèn shi zhè xiē zì qǐng dú yì dú
sentences.english: .. “Who knows these characters? Please read them!”

sentences.traditional: 劉備站在後面，說：“這是官府寫給大家的，
sentences.pinyin: liú bèi zhàn zài hòu miàn shuō zhè shì guān fǔ xiě gěi dà jiā de
sentences.english: Liu Bei stood at the back and said, “This was written by the government to everyone.

sentences.simplified: 上面说的是，现在北边的黄军越来越多，他们做的坏事也越来越多，
sentences.traditional: 上面說的是，現在北邊的黃軍越來越多，他們做的壞事也越來越多，

sentences.english: It says that the yellow soldiers are growing in number in the north. They are also doing more and more bad things.

sentences.simplified: 官府希望大家帮忙，一起打黄军。
sentences.traditional: 官府希望大家幫忙，一起打黃軍。
sentences.pinyin: guān fǔ xī wàng dà jiā bāng máng yì qǐ dǎ huáng jūn
sentences.english: The government hopes that everyone can help to fight the yellow soldiers together.

sentences.simplified: 谁帮的忙最大，官府就让谁做将军。”
sentences.traditional: 誰幫的忙最大，官府就讓誰做將軍。”
sentences.pinyin: shéi bāng de máng zuì dà guān fǔ jiù ràng shéi zuò jiāng jūn
sentences.english: The government will make whoever helps the most a general.”

sentences.simplified: 刘备刚读完，就有人高兴地说：“我去打黄军，我要做将军！”
sentences.traditional: 劉備剛讀完，就有人高興地說：“我去打黃軍，我要做將軍！”

sentences.english: As soon as Liu Bei had finished reading, someone said happily, “I will fight the yellow soldiers. I will be a general!”

sentences.traditional: 也有人害怕地說：“黃軍的人那麼多，

sentences.english: Another person was afraid and said, “There are so many yellow soldiers.

sentences.english: The local government can’t do anything. If I go, will I be able to come back?”

sentences.english: Another person said angrily, “I won’t go. I only help people who treat me well.

sentences.simplified: 虽然黄军不对，但官府也不是好人！”
sentences.traditional: 雖然黃軍不對，但官府也不是好人！”
sentences.pinyin: suī rán huáng jūn bú duì dàn guān fǔ yě bú shì hǎo rén

sentences.traditional: 劉備沒有說話，安靜地站在街邊，他知道每個人的意思。

sentences.english: Liu Bei didn’t speak. He stood quietly on the side of the street. He knew what everyone meant.

sentences.traditional: 他也有很多話想說，但是沒有人懂他。
sentences.pinyin: tā yě yǒu hěn duō huà xiǎng shuō dàn shì méi yǒu rén dǒng tā
sentences.english: He also had many things he wanted to say, but no one understood him.

sentence_translations: Liu Bei
It was a day 2,000 years ago.
A man was walking in the street. He was in his twenties. His surname was Liu, and his name was Liu Bei.
Liu Bei would make little things. When he had finished making them, he would sell them on the street.
He had been selling them for four or five years already, and they were selling pretty well.
But since last winter, fewer people had been buying them.
Liu Bei knew why. Last winter was particularly cold.
Many people had nothing to eat, and the number of sick people was especially high.
Some people who were having an especially hard time went to the government to ask the officials for help, ..
.. but they did not get any help.
Later, the winter passed by. Many people did not see the spring; they died in the winter.
Thinking about this, Liu Bei became a little angry.
In the minds of the officials, becoming a bigger official was the most important thing.
They were busy looking for money every day.
They even made the people who had hard lives give money to them, and they didn’t remember the people who died at all.
The yellow soldiers in the north fought good people and took things from people who had hard lives.
The officials only knew how to be afraid and did not go and fight them.
How could officials like this care about people who had hard lives?
Liu Bei walked slowly, and he was a little angry with himself.
He was angry that he didn’t have any money.
If he had money, he could help the people who had hard lives and do more to make the country better.
The government building was in front. Some people were standing in the street.
They were looking at a piece of paper on the gate of the government building. Many characters were written on the paper.
Many people who had never been to school and did not know the characters asked loudly, ..
.. “Who knows these characters? Please read them!”
Liu Bei stood at the back and said, “This was written by the government to everyone.
It says that the yellow soldiers are growing in number in the north. They are also doing more and more bad things.
The government hopes that everyone can help to fight the yellow soldiers together.
The government will make whoever helps the most a general.”
As soon as Liu Bei had finished reading, someone said happily, “I will fight the yellow soldiers. I will be a general!”
Another person was afraid and said, “There are so many yellow soldiers.
The local government can’t do anything. If I go, will I be able to come back?”
Another person said angrily, “I won’t go. I only help people who treat me well.
Although the yellow soldiers are wrong, the officials are also bad people!”
Liu Bei didn’t speak. He stood quietly on the side of the street. He knew what everyone meant.
He also had many things he wanted to say, but no one understood him.
